stem: What goals do organizations like the AFL-CIO seek to achieve in the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: Improving working conditions and opportunities for union workers

options.label: B
options.text: Finding labor sources for manufacturing in regions outside of the United States

options.label: C
options.text: Deregulating businesses and reducing corporate taxes

options.label: D
options.text: Decreasing the political influence of labor union leaders

notes: Extracted from a 2023 STAAR US History question about AFL-CIO goals with 4 answer choices.
